question: Can the prospective immutable-plan adapter refuse malformed cell coverage before native analyze computes pooled acceptance slack or calls judge_cell, while preserving native analyze output on one complete prospective model-free fixture?
distinct_from: Existing standalone guard unittest qualification; this prerequisite targets the real analyze entry boundary and ID-to-geometry binding, not another guard suite.
expected_effect: No stochastic estimate: exact structural refusal and equality of native pure-judge JSON. No model output or historical rejudgment.

input_contract.plan: Sealed plan.json: exact four launches; synthetic-g901-c17 bound to group=901/c=17/S=3; fixed L=100/swa_cells=40/build=[17], rules=v1, fixture SHA-256; all sources/adapter/plan/fixture are sealed by SHA256SUMS.
input_contract.fixture: Sealed fixture.json constructed solely from integer ranges and literal dictionaries; 64 synthetic token IDs, three identical controls, two arms, pinned checkpoint per launch. Honest/flag_on expect PASS; both mutants lower draft_n_accepted from 40 to 0 and expect DETECTED. No historical/native run data was read.
input_contract.custody: Vendored pinned native kpf174 and sibling kpf13 modules plus guard. Entire local import closure, adapter, launcher, fixture and plan sealed in SHA256SUMS; pre/post execution and each mutation boundary verify; imports only vendored module or stdlib.

adapter_contract: Refuse unknown/missing/extra launches before entering native analyze.

For each launch, compare exact cell ID set to plan; compare each cell group/c/S and cell field to predeclared entry; compare geo L/swa_cells/build to plan. Reject booleans where integers are required.

Call validate_launch for every launch before ANY native analyze, acceptance_spread or judge_cell call. mutant_partial=True only for mut_partial_noop. Any error returns a structural refusal artifact and no native verdict.

Only after all launches pass, call pinned native analyze with exact rules and no discovered prior_191a. Retain structural qualification separately from native verdict; never publish a KPF correctness conclusion.
Use a callback-entry witness or AST-controlled wrapper to prove malformed plan/input refuses before native acceptance_spread; a mere invalid returned native verdict does not establish ordering.

Assert native analyze output equals adapter-delegated output exactly on complete synthetic fixture; separately prove missing/extra launch, renamed ID with mismatched geometry, and one incomplete launch refuse before delegate entry. These are integration controls, not a replay of standalone guard tests.

smoke_contract.launcher: launch.sh -> canonical filler_run15.sh -> smoke.py -> adapter.py. Dryrun/smoke uses FILLER_DRYRUN=1 or FILLER_SMOKE=1 and requires distinct FILLER_DRYRUN_RESULT_PATH. Launcher precondition verifies SHA256SUMS.
smoke_contract.region: Engine exports FILLER_ID, FILLER_END, FILLER_STOPFILE, FILLER_CPUS and tasksets the job. Worker preserves os.sched_getaffinity(0), never widens it; engine owns grant validation.
smoke_contract.execution: Engine dryrun uses one structural control and SMOKE_ONLY at distinct FILLER_DRYRUN_RESULT_PATH. Full mode uses all ten controls and MODEL_FREE_QUALIFICATION at out/RESULT.json. Both execute only native pure analyze on synthetic inputs.
smoke_contract.deadline: 120-second workload limit reduced to preserve seven-second cleanup reserve before FILLER_END; cleanup bounded to seven seconds.
smoke_contract.cleanup: Captured child only: TERM, 2s wait, KILL, 2s wait, reap and ps timeout 1s. Cleanup exceptions fail closed and produce END receipt; success result requires proven absence.
smoke_contract.stop: Stop once integration controls answer question or on first custody/refusal-order/equality/launch failure. No inference or follow-on run.

readiness_blockers: No dryrun or full qualification executed.
Live registry duplicate discovery and owner review required before publication.
historical_boundary: R5 g0-S2-B remains exposed/INVALID and must not be rerun or redrawn; source integration cannot qualify historical a1f0c8cf9 custody or establish physical-layout equivalence.
remaining: Prepared only; owner review, engine dryrun and full qualification remain unexecuted; no publication.
decision_rule: Full model-free qualification PASS requires exact native equality, declared honest/flag_on PASS and both mutants DETECTED, all ten structural refusals before native entry, identical pre/post input seals, worker rc=0 and proven owned-PID absence. Dryrun synthetic smoke checks one refusal and cannot satisfy full completion.
notes: 300 seconds is the minimum admission reservation upper bound; native workload hard limit120 and cleanup7 unchanged. Owner reviewed under explicit whole-handoff reassignment. Synthetic smoke only; no historical rejudgment.
